# cargo-forge

> Rust project generator with 7 typed templates — CLI, API server, WASM, game engine, embedded, library, workspace. cargo install cargo-forge.

cargo-forge is maintained by marcuspat (Agentic Engineer — Platform Engineering × AI-assisted development).

## Links

- [Landing page](https://marcuspat.github.io/cargo-forge/): overview, features, FAQ
- [Source code](https://github.com/marcuspat/cargo-forge): README, issues, releases
## Install

```
cargo install cargo-forge
```
